project.title: ShipSafe AI: Pre-PR Production-Readiness Gate on IBM Db2
project.short_description: Tells you whether a change is safe to open as a pull request. Scans for leaked secrets, SQL injection, risky code, vulnerable dependencies and failing tests; gives one deterministic PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS / BLOCKED decision; cites the governing team policy for every finding using LangChain + IBM Db2 vector search; and keeps assessments, risk trends, API tokens and an audit trail in IBM Db2. Ships as a web app, REST API, CLI (with SARIF) and an MCP server for IBM Bob.
project.category: DevSecOps / AI Developer Tooling / Vector Search

members.name: Devanshu Sharma
members.role: Solo developer: scanners, IBM Db2 schema and persistence, LangChain Db2 vector retrieval, API, web app, MCP server

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition 12.1.5 (Docker, icr.io/db2_community/db2; also created via the VS Code Db2 extension)
features_used: Relational tables with foreign keys, CHECK and UNIQUE constraints
Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) column and VECTOR_DISTANCE (COSINE) search
OLAP window functions (LAG, ROW_NUMBER) in views
Append-only audit table and hashed API tokens
